history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration address the high concentration of geographical representation in the resident coordinator/humanitarian coordinator talent pipeline by attracting and nurturing more personnel from programme countries.
history.administration_response: As at 31 December 2024, 62 per cent of the 45 members of the resident coordinator/humanitarian coordinator talent pipeline were from programme countries. A call for expressions of interest to join the talent pipeline was issued in January 2025 in order to replenish the pipeline and continue to increase geographical diversity. Eligible candidates are being assessed and the outcome of the selection process will be communicated by July 2025.
history.board_assessment: Geographical diversity is crucial in aligning the resident coordinator’s abilities with the needs of countries and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. Although many measures have been taken, the concentration of geographical representation has not been duly addressed. The Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: In paragraph 380 of its report, the Board recommended that the Administration address the high concentration of geographical representation in the resident coordinator/humanitarian coordinator talent pipeline by attracting and nurturing more personnel from programme countries.
history.reference_raw: Report of the Board for the year ended 31 December 2023 9
history.sg_progress: The selection process for the resident coordinator/humanitarian coordinator talent pipeline intake was finalized in July 2025, resulting in the addition of 77 new members and bringing the total to 122. As at 31 July 2025, 60 per cent of pipeline members were from programme countries. With this intake, the number of nationalities represented increased from 30 to 59, a 96 per cent rise. These figures demonstrate that the Administration has effectively addressed concerns regarding the concentration of geographical representation within the resident coordinator/ humanitarian coordinator talent pipeline, successfully attracting and nurturing talent from programme countries. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
